name: aurix-debugger-workspace
description: Builds the aurix-dbg server and packages the VS Code extension with it

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:extension
scripts.package: npm run build:server && npm --prefix vscode-aurix-tcf-debugger run package
scripts.release: npm run build:server && npm --prefix vscode-aurix-tcf-debugger run release
